pullRequest.title: Bill lessons in started 15-minute blocks
pullRequest.body: Parents are billed per started quarter hour now, as agreed at the October staff meeting: a 50-minute lesson is billed as an hour and a 40-minute one as 45 minutes. A lesson that ends exactly on a block is not rounded up.
pullRequest.author: sam

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Could you add a test for a lesson of exactly 45 minutes? I want to be sure a full block never gets bumped up to the next one.

comments.body: While you're in here, could the invoices go out to the parents by email at the end of the month? Would save me an evening every month.
